title: Branch+PR workflow commit routing for dev/qa/dm

questions.question: DM is delivering #789. Where should DM commit the README and CHANGELOG updates?
questions.expected: DM should commit delivery work to the feature branch squidsquad/dm/789 using git_ops.py commit-code, then commit state changes (.squidsquad/) to main using git_ops.py commit-state.

questions.question: QA just verified issue #123 on branch squidsquad/skill/123. Where do QA's verification commits go?
questions.expected: QA's verification results go on the issue's existing feature branch (squidsquad/skill/123) using git_ops.py commit-code. State changes (.squidsquad/ iteration logs, working state) go on main using git_ops.py commit-state.
